Name: Global Account Search & Territory Alignment
Description:
Enables sales representatives to search for accounts and addresses globally and aligns them to appropriate territories based on ZIP codes.

* Allows users to search for accounts and addresses across the entire organization.
* Filters search results based on dynamic visibility rules.
* Automatically aligns accounts to territories using ZIP code mapping.
* Maintains a history of territory alignments for auditing and reporting.
Primary Objects: GAS_Alignment_History_vts__c, Address_vod__c, TEVA_Zip_To_Terr__c, GAS_Visibility_Configuration__c, GAS_Hierarchical_Setting__c, Account_Territory_Loader_vod__c

Name: Third-Party Logistics Integration Tracking
Description:
Monitors and tracks changes to Healthcare Professional (HCP) demographics and addresses to ensure accurate data synchronization with third-party logistics partners.

* Monitors updates to critical account and address information.
* Automatically captures modification timestamps when specific fields are changed.
* Facilitates seamless data synchronization with external fulfillment and logistics vendors.

Name: Data Encryption & Security Services
Description:
Secures sensitive integration identifiers and business keys by encrypting data before it is saved in the system.

* Encrypts unique business identifiers such as Federation IDs and Brand IDs.
* Ensures sensitive integration keys are stored securely using base64 encoding.
* Protects data integrity and confidentiality across account and product records.

Name: Sandbox Data Masking & Anonymization
Description:
Protects sensitive customer data in non-production environments by masking emails and identifiers, preventing accidental outbound communications during testing.

* Automatically anonymizes customer contact email addresses after a sandbox refresh.
* Appends invalid suffixes to email addresses to block real email transmissions.
* Modifies integration identifiers to prevent unintended system integrations during testing.

Name: Account Merge & Territory Data Consolidation
Description:
Manages the consolidation of territory and activity data when duplicate account records are merged.

* Aggregates territory alignment records during an account merge.
* Consolidates territory-specific field data, including year-to-date activities.
* Ensures historical call and activity data is preserved and accurately reflected on the surviving account record.

Name: Territory Activity Calculation
Description:
Calculates and maintains year-to-date call activity metrics for sales territories.

* Automatically calculates year-to-date call activity levels based on logged interactions.
* Resets activity metrics according to the current calendar year.
* Provides sales teams with accurate, up-to-date visibility into territory engagement levels.

Name: External System Schema API
Description:
Provides an integration endpoint that exposes system schema details to external applications for data archiving and synchronization. Features include:
- Exposing field properties and profile schemas via a secure API endpoint.
- Allowing external applications to dynamically build compliant database tables.
- Facilitating seamless data archiving and external reporting capabilities.

Name: Educational Call Resource Tracking
Description:
Enables field representatives to log and track educational materials shared with medical professionals during interactions. Features include:
- Allowing representatives to register digital literature, posters, or videos provided during a call.
- Providing a guided interface for identifying and selecting disseminated resources.
- Enhancing compliance and reporting on educational material distribution.

Name: Remote Meeting Splash Screens
Description:
Manages the display of splash screens and introductory visuals for remote meetings and virtual engagements. Features include:
* Providing customizable splash screens for remote meeting sessions.
* Enhancing the professional appearance of virtual engagements with healthcare professionals.
* Supporting multiple variations of introductory screens for different meeting types.

Name: Sync Tracking Maintenance
Description:
Manages the cleanup and maintenance of synchronization tracking schedules to ensure optimal system performance. Features include:
* Automatically removing outdated or unnecessary synchronization tracking schedules.
* Optimizing system performance by clearing legacy sync data.
* Ensuring background synchronization processes run efficiently.

Name: Metadata Package Management
Description:
Facilitates the organization, retrieval, and packaging of system metadata components for deployment and version control.

* Provides a user interface to track and manage metadata components linked to specific development branches.
* Retrieves specified metadata components and stores them as compressed files for easy transfer.
* Consolidates metadata from multiple branches into a single parent package to streamline deployments.
* Builds custom manifests by linking selected org metadata components to a parent package record.

Name: Veeva Sync and Tracking Management
Description:
Manages the configuration and scheduling of data synchronization between Veeva CRM and offline devices to ensure data consistency.

* Configures synchronization settings for critical CRM data, including sample limits.
* Manages and schedules sync tracking processes to monitor data flow.
* Allows administrators to delete or modify sync tracking schedules to optimize system performance.

Name: Educational Call Resource Management
Description:
Empowers clinical representatives to manage and register educational materials shared with medical professionals during calls. Features include:
* Allowing users to register digital literature, posters, or videos disseminated during educational calls.
* Assisting field representatives with identifying and tracking specific educational resources utilized.
* Enhancing compliance and reporting by maintaining a record of shared materials.

Name: Remote Meeting Experience Management
Description:
Manages the visual and interactive elements of remote meetings to provide a professional and branded experience for healthcare professionals, as well as handling attendee data. Features include:
- Providing customizable splash screens for remote meetings.
- Enhancing the waiting room experience for attendees joining virtual calls.
- Supporting the display of branding, instructions, or compliance messaging before a remote meeting begins.
- Managing remote meeting attendee data and triggering related business logic upon attendee updates.

Name: Field Coaching Report Management
Description: Manages the end-to-end lifecycle of field coaching reports for sales leadership. Features include: - Coordinating the creation and finalization of coaching sessions. - Managing attachment-level validation and locking mechanisms. - Handling ownership record sharing and status modifications for employee coaching reports. - Facilitating archival data pull-forwards for historical coaching data.

Name: Sample Lot Catalog Synchronization
Description:
Maintains accurate and up-to-date sample inventory records by synchronizing master catalog data with individual sample lots. Features include: 
- Automatically cascading updates made to active flags, unit-of-measure values, or expiration dates from the Lot Catalog to matching Sample Lots. 
- Ensuring data consistency across the sample management process. 
- Reducing manual data entry and preventing compliance discrepancies in sample inventory.

Name: Multichannel Consent Management
Description:
Manages the capture and processing of consent for multichannel communications. Features include:
* Automating consent processing for multichannel communications.
* Ensuring compliance with data privacy regulations by tracking consent status.
* Triggering updates based on changes to multichannel consent records.

Name: External System Integration & Archiving
Description:
Facilitates the integration between Salesforce and external archiving systems like Heroku. Features include:
* Providing an integrated API endpoint that exposes field properties and profile schemas.
* Allowing external applications to build schema-compliant database tables for archiving purposes.
* Ensuring data structure consistency between Salesforce and external data stores.

Name: Data Synchronization Management
Description:
Manages the scheduling and tracking of data synchronization processes. Features include:
* Allowing administrators or automated processes to delete or reset sync tracking schedules.
* Ensuring accurate tracking of data synchronization between offline devices and the server.
* Maintaining system performance by clearing outdated synchronization logs or schedules.

Name: Medical Insight Management
Description:
Automates and orchestrates the lifecycle of medical insights captured by field medical teams. Features include:
- Automatically date-stamping manager and director approvals.
- Copying relevant fields and locking record types to ensure data integrity.
- Triggering safety escalation alerts based on insight severity.
- Facilitating internal handoffs and managing review dates.
- Formatting data attributes and handling transition updates for seamless processing.

Name: Medical Inquiry Management
Description:
Manages the lifecycle, fulfillment, and system integration of medical inquiries. Features include:
* Synchronizing case snapshot details from manually created medical inquiries to their corresponding fulfillment records.
* Supporting bi-directional integration between Veeva CRM and Veeva Vault for medical information inquiries.
* Routing pending inquiries to appropriate teams or systems.
* Aligning territory access vectors and managing user assignments on medical request objects to ensure proper visibility and handling.

Name: User Profile Management
Description:
Automates the management and standardization of user profile information. Features include:
* Automatically generating custom email addresses based on user first and last name inputs.
* Updating user records with constructed email addresses to ensure standardized communication channels across the organization.

Name: Educational Call Resource Management
Description:
Empowers clinical representatives to manage and register educational materials shared with medical professionals during calls. Features include:
* Allowing users to register digital literature, posters, or videos disseminated during educational calls.
* Assisting field representatives with identifying and tracking specific educational resources utilized.
* Enhancing compliance and reporting by maintaining a record of shared materials.
